claims.statement: For Y=R^T X with R^T R=I_3 from independent cap-one inputs and Q=lambda1 Y1^2+lambda2 Y2^2-mu Y3^2 with lambda1,lambda2,mu>=1, every Borel E subset [0,infinity) satisfies P(Q in E)<=pi*sqrt(2)|E|. The proof mollifies the rough 3D projection density, preserves all line-X-ray caps under convolution, applies the exact ruled Jacobian, and passes back by L1 convergence.

For q=y1^2+y2^2-y3^2 and negative levels, G_pm(s,theta,u)=((u-s/u)e_theta/2, pm(u+s/u)/2), u>=sqrt(s), has q(G_pm)=-s and absolute Jacobian (1-s/u^2)/4. Thus the rough two-sheet interval problem is exactly a reciprocal transverse shear of a Lorentz-null line.
